title: feature request: in the desktop settings dialog, keep system wallpapers and my own wallpapers separated
line: The wallpaper picker lists your own wallpapers first, then the system ones, each group in alphabetical order.
explanation: Since Plasma 6.5 the Image wallpaper picker wraps its model in a QML KSortFilterProxyModel sorted only by name, so wallpapers the user added (in ~/.local/share/wallpapers or through Add…) end up scattered among the system ones; before that they were listed first. A second QML proxy grouping by the 'removable' role isn't enough, because rows inserted while the list loads are only appended to the end of their group. The change replaces the QML sort model with a small C++ QSortFilterProxyModel (ImageSortModel) whose lessThan puts removable (user) wallpapers first and otherwise keeps the same case-insensitive name comparison.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: list the user's own wallpapers before the system ones

Sorting the wallpapers alphabetically mixed the ones the user added in
among the system wallpapers. Sort them in a small proxy model instead,
which lists the user's own wallpapers first and keeps both alphabetical.

BUG: 516633

+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#include "imagesortmodel.h"
+
+#include "model/imageroles.h"
+
+ImageSortModel::ImageSortModel(QObject *parent)
+    : QSortFilterProxyModel(parent)
+{
+    setSortCaseSensitivity(Qt::CaseInsensitive);
+    sort(0);
+
+    connect(this, &ImageSortModel::rowsInserted, this, &ImageSortModel::countChanged);
+    connect(this, &ImageSortModel::rowsRemoved, this, &ImageSortModel::countChanged);
+    connect(this, &ImageSortModel::modelReset, this, &ImageSortModel::countChanged);
+}
+
+bool ImageSortModel::lessThan(const QModelIndex &source_left, const QModelIndex &source_right) const
+{
+    const bool leftRemovable = source_left.data(ImageRoles::RemovableRole).toBool();
+    const bool rightRemovable = source_right.data(ImageRoles::RemovableRole).toBool();
+
+    if (leftRemovable != rightRemovable) {
+        return leftRemovable;
+    }
+
+    return QSortFilterProxyModel::lessThan(source_left, source_right);
+}
diff --git a/wallpapers/image/plugin/imagesortmodel.h b/wallpapers/image/plugin/imagesortmodel.h
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..17cb7df158
--- /dev/null
+++ b/wallpapers/image/plugin/imagesortmodel.h
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#pragma once
+
+#include <QSortFilterProxyModel>
+#include <qqmlintegration.h>
+
+/**
+ * Sorts wallpapers alphabetically, listing the user's own wallpapers before the system ones.
+ */
+class ImageSortModel : public QSortFilterProxyModel
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+    QML_ELEMENT
+
+    Q_PROPERTY(int count READ rowCount NOTIFY countChanged)
+
+public:
+    explicit ImageSortModel(QObject *parent = nullptr);
+
+Q_SIGNALS:
+    void countChanged();
+
+protected:
+    bool lessThan(const QModelIndex &source_left, const QModelIndex &source_right) const override;
+};

media.caption: Master: three user wallpapers Aaa-mine, Mmm-mine and Zzz-mine are scattered: first, between Milky Way and Mountain, and last after Waterfall.
With the fix: Aaa-mine, Mmm-mine, Zzz-mine come first, then the system wallpapers from Air onwards; the current wallpaper (Cascade) is still highlighted.

review.text: Clean, minimal fix for the Plasma 6.5 regression that interleaved user wallpapers with system ones. Moving the two-key sort (RemovableRole first, then case-insensitive DisplayRole) into a dedicated C++ QSortFilterProxyModel (ImageSortModel) avoids QML proxy ordering glitches on incremental inserts while keeping indexOf/openContainingFolder mapping and count notifications intact. Before/after screenshots and regression checks thoroughly verify ordering, selection highlighting, adding, and deleting.
